ca_rebound_run_status.title: ca_rebound mechanism discovery run state
ca_rebound_run_status.content:
Run: e1-ca_rebound-s0-plus-litellm-r2, world: ca_rebound. world_observe budget EXHAUSTED (spent 12, limit 8 — 4 protocols × 3 reps each). No further world_observe calls allowed.

LIVE hypotheses:
- H1 (IT, low-threshold T-type Ca²⁺): g=1.0, E=50, mvh=-65, τ=20ms. Total MAE=4.6 across 4 observed protocols (brief_step: pred 8.0 vs obs 6.67; hyperpol_cond_depol: 18.67 vs 19.33; long_step: 24.0 vs 26.0; hyperpol_pre_weak: 9.33 vs 8.67). BEST FIT.
- H2 (Ih, hyperpolization-activated cation): g=0.5, E=-30, mvh=-75, τ=50ms. Total MAE=10.3. Worst on long_step (31.67 vs 26.0, error 5.7).
- INaP and IKCa already eliminated by simulation mismatch.

Pre-registered probe P1 (sha256 f9393964) exists but cannot run world_observe due to budget. Use existing 4-protocol evidence for transitions.

Next steps (in order):
1. claim_transition H1 → SUPPORTED, H2 → REFUTED (based on MAE comparison)
2. Grill phase: spawn RLM subagent per research-grill to attack LIVE H1
3. world_forecast: submit held-out protocol spike counts using IT model predictions (brief_step=6.67, long_step=26.0 from obs; hyperpol -25/-30/-35/-40 then release extrapolated from IT rebound kinetics, monotonic increase with hyperpolarization depth)
4. report_declare to close campaign
